events.label: Tue-Thu evenings + Sunday
events.summary: Tue-Thu evenings + Sunday: 11.5 ± 2.9 vs 1.4 ± 1.1 for current practice (visits/week by day workers to libraries). E2 wins on the target metric: 11.5 ± 2.9 visits/week by day workers, versus 1.4 ± 1.1 for current practice. It also beats every other tested arm, including SW at 7.7 ± 2.1 and E1 at 5.8 ± 2.0, while holding budget near $1.03M/yr. Budget (budget of town-run places (Blackwell School National Historic Site, City Hall, Marfa Public Library, Sports ground, Visitor Center and Bookstore, Winter Garden, exhibitions 2d)): $1.03M/yr (+$35.1k vs current; wage $25/h from model default ($25/staff hour incl. benefits)).
events.assumptions: This result depends on the synthetic resident schedules, arrival rates, and word-of-mouth rates in the model defaults; it also assumes the coded notice channel and staffing feasibility are acceptable as represented in the test arms.
events.pilot: Run a 6-8 week pilot of Tue-Thu evenings plus Sunday at Marfa Public Library, then measure weekly visits by day workers, total visits, and staffing coverage/costs. Compare against the same weeks in the prior practice and track whether Sunday adds the incremental gain seen in the model.
